entries.principle: Safety and security; proportionality and Do No Harm
entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021), paragraphs 25-27; Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII (17 November 2025), Articles 11(1)-(3) and 18(1)
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025
entries.why_here: The refusal-path test rejected the impossible GPA 9.9 and exam score -5 before a model call; validation is an engineering risk-control measure under general safety and risk-management duties, not a statutory range rule.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021), paragraphs 28-29; Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII (17 November 2025), Article 6
entries.instrument: Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan adopted by referendum on 15 March 2026
entries.why_here: Baseline matched-pair tests observed flips for name_language (2/40), gender_coded_name (4/40), and university (1/40); blinding reduces direct exposure to irrelevant fields, while zero after-flips are by construction and do not prove general fairness.

entries.principle: Legitimate purpose; privacy and data protection; fairness and non-discrimination
entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021), paragraphs 25-29 and 32-34; Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII, Article 6
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Personal Data and Their Protection No. 94-V of 21 May 2013
entries.why_here: Part 4 refused 4/6 test requests for a prohibited purpose, a minor, no consent, and invalid inputs; the blanket under-18 rule is a prototype policy rather than a directly stated statutory requirement and needs fund-specific review.

entries.principle: Transparency and explainability; responsibility and accountability; privacy and data protection
entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021), paragraphs 32-34 and 37-43; Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII, Articles 8(1)-(2) and 15(2)(3)
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025
entries.why_here: The submitted JSONL log contains 406 records with decisions, reason codes, controls, fields shown/withheld, model metadata, input hash, and timestamps; it supports lifecycle accountability and documentation, but the law does not prescribe this exact JSONL format.

entries.principle: Human oversight and determination; responsibility and accountability
entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021), paragraphs 35-36 and 42-43; Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Artificial Intelligence No. 230-VIII, Article 8(1)-(2)
entries.instrument: Digital Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 255-VIII of 9 January 2026
entries.why_here: The harness escalated 58/400 measured profiles (14.5%) and flagged 2 additional refusal-path test requests; the notebook only records an escalation outcome and does not implement authorized-specialist reconsideration or an applicant-facing appeal process.
